errors.text_span: а най-ниският – за Румъния, който е около 10%
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies Romania as the country with the lowest value. In the chart, Romania's bar is one of the highest, at approximately 36%. The lowest values, around 12-13%, are for countries like Slovenia, Czechia, and Denmark.

errors.text_span: Останалите страни показват стойности в диапазона между 15% и 35%
errors.evidence: This statement is an over-generalization as several countries have values outside this range. For example, Slovenia, Czechia, and Denmark are below 15%, while Romania, Serbia, North Macedonia, and Turkey are above 35%.
